newsitem.title: USA: Boeing expects NLRB to issue complaint.
newsitem.headline: Boeing expects NLRB to issue complaint.

text.p: Boeing Co said Tuesday that the National Labor Relations Board has indicated to Boeing it will issue a complaint on Wedneseday against the company.

The complaint alleges Boeing has unlawfully assigned duties performed by expediters, represented by the International Association of Machinists and Aerospace Workers (IAM&AW), to salaried material planners.
The issuance of a complaint means the NLRB considers the issues in this case to be complicated enough to demand that a hearing be held to review the evidence.
"We welcome the opportunity to resolve the misunderstandings that led to the filing of charges by the IAM&AW," said Tom Schick of Boeing Commercial Airplane Group in a statement.

Boeing said the hearing will give it the opportunity to prove that by implementing process improvements and job changes it did not violate the law or its labor agreements and did not transfer hourly work to salaried employees.
